description: This file defines utility functions and type assertions for testing directory surfaces in a plugin SDK. It includes functions to create a test runtime environment and to validate and extract properties from directory objects, relying on external types from the 'openclaw/plugin-sdk'.

methods.name: export function createDirectoryTestRuntime() { createDirectoryTestRuntime
methods.description: Creates a mock runtime environment with log and error functions, and an exit function that throws an error with the exit code.

methods.name: export function expectDirectorySurface(directory: unknown): DirectorySurface { expectDirectorySurface
methods.description: Validates that the provided directory object contains the expected 'listPeers' and 'listGroups' methods, and returns an object with these methods.

ctags.name: listGroups
ctags.pattern: /^  const { listPeers, listGroups } = directory as ChannelDirectoryAdapter;$/

ctags.pattern: /^  const { listPeers, listGroups } = directory as ChannelDirectoryAdapter;$/
